Something people are missing:
"Al" in Arabic is the definite article, "the". "The God" is "Al Ilah", shortened to Allah.
In Aramaic the definite article is the suffix "a" at the end (or "o" in Syriac). So Alah-a ("The God") or Aloh-o.
